about_the_game:
This add-on content contains the following.

●Hunter Layered Armor: Noblesse Earcuff
●Hunter Layered Armor: Noblesse Mail
●Hunter Layered Armor: Noblesse Braces
●Hunter Layered Armor: Noblesse Coil
●Hunter Layered Armor: Noblesse Greaves

Beautiful armor with a classical, sophisticated design. Recommended for hunters who value history and tradition.

*You can apply Layered Armor from the Hunter Appearance option in the Appearance menu in your tent.
*This item changes the appearance of your hunter. It does not affect stats or abilities. A weapon is not included.
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
